description: Improves vulnerability prioritization by enhancing CVSS scores with exploit intelligence. Combines data from CISA KEV, EPSS, Metasploit, and other sources to create actionable severity ratings that reflect real-world threat levels.

name: AspXVenom
description: ASPX Shellcode Ceasar Encrypted Generator is a Python script automating shellcode generation, embedding, encryption, and execution in an ASP.NET webshell for penetration testing. This tool streamlines tasks for OSEP challenges, creating encoded shellcodes using user-provided LHOST and LPORT, and setting up Metasploit handlers.

name: Attack_project
description: A Bash script for network attack simulations using Ping Flood, Metasploit scanning, and ARP Spoofing (MITM). It automates security testing by scanning networks, selecting attack methods, executing attacks, and logging results. Designed for Kali Linux, this tool is intended for ethical hacking and security research. 🚀

name: Cyber-Attack-Simulation-Vulnerability-Assessment
description: Simulated cyber-attacks using Metasploit, Nmap, and Nessus to identify system vulnerabilities and recommend mitigations.

name: nemesys
description: Nemesys is an ethical cybersecurity tool designed to automate exploitation and post-exploitation tasks using Metasploit. It enhances target attacks, privilege escalation, and system analysis while providing intelligent reporting through cloud-based large language models (LLMs). 🚀📊

name: NetworkNemesis
description: Network Nemesis is an advanced network attack and exploitation framework designed for penetration testers and cybersecurity professionals. It automates password brute-forcing, ARP spoofing, Metasploit payload creation, and network scanning while maintaining structured logging for analysis.
